assets.generation_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original transparent sprite atlas for a 3D racing game crowd, viewed from trackside at medium distance
Primary request: create SIX separate realistic adult British Grand Prix spectators as full-body cutouts in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid. Top row: three standing spectators with clearly visible separate arms and legs; one neutral stance, one clapping, one with one arm lifted. Bottom row: three seated spectators, visible head, shoulders, torso, arms and legs; one neutral, one leaning forward, one clapping. Give each cell generous empty transparent padding, and keep every figure entirely inside its own cell without overlap.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background everywhere outside each figure, no ground plane and no shadow.
Style/medium: natural daylight game-asset photography, realistic cloth folds and human proportions, clean crisp edges at sprite scale.
Clothing: varied muted navy, charcoal, off-white, olive, ochre, burgundy casual jackets/shirts; mixed adult genders and varied natural skin tones and hair. No team kit, logos, brand marks, text, flags, helmets or props.
Composition/framing: all figures face mostly toward the camera at similar scale; align standing feet along top-row cell bottoms and seated figures along bottom-row cell bottoms; no cropped limbs. Keep grid cell boundaries visually empty for UV slicing.
Constraints: exactly six distinct figures, no extra people, no repeated clones, no background, no watermark, no outlines, no typography.
assets.transparency_edit_prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: original transparent spectator sprite atlas for a 3D racing game
Primary request: remove the entire dark gradient background and all floor/contact shadows from the six-figure 3-column by 2-row atlas. Make every pixel outside the actual people genuinely transparent alpha. Preserve all six people exactly: same faces, bodies, clothing, poses, positions, proportions and cell layout. Keep fine hair and clothing edges clean with no black matte fringe.
Constraints: exactly six isolated figures in the same grid cells, no new details, no text, no replacement background, no shadow, no edge halo. Export as RGBA PNG with real alpha transparency.
